_format: Phase 15.1 registry. Copy to /etc/homelab-model-helper/config.json (root:root 0644). Models and prices are configuration; callers select only a route. A route's summed provider timeouts plus 30 seconds must not exceed RuntimeMaxSec=270.

haiku.note: cheapest tier on Claude Pro; alias undocumented in --help but functional

mini.note: the subscription's mini tier; gpt-5.4-mini is refused on a ChatGPT account

luna.note: utility route; published OpenAI serving-provider rates per million tokens

sol.note: registered but not routed; maximum published serving-provider rates because Gateway routing is dynamic by default

_caps: Per subscription provider, one count each. owner_reserve is the ADR-026 owner floor: unattended calls stop at per_x - owner_reserve.per_x of the same count.
_spend: USD rolling windows, attended and unattended independently. The ledger must be explicitly initialized by the installer; a missing or malformed ledger fails closed.
